summary: Fixed Item 6A/7A name overflow and cell border collisions, Page 2 Taxpayer/Buyer Name comb-tick strike-through (via shared [data-overflow-of] white band at 8835479d; per-form comb mask removed), Schedule 1 Classification code, right-alignment, and padding, Schedule 2 Item 6 integer count, and Schedule 1 screen labels (OCT/TCT/CCT No., Area (sq.m.)). Remaining items are screen-only (bir-core screen formatting of txtTotalN and nsh/screens/form input widths).

defects.where: Page 1, Part I Item 7A (Buyer's Name) and Item 6A (Seller's Name)
defects.what: Long Buyer's Name overflowed its right cell border and collided with Buyer's Registered Address because print-overrides/1706-2018.css forced font-size:6.7px !important over bir-print's dynamic shrink-to-fit.

defects.where: Page 1, Part I Item 6A/7A Registered Addresses and Page 2 Schedule 1 text cells
defects.what: Address and Schedule 1 text sat flush against left/right cell borders without horizontal padding.
Long Buyer's Name (>27 chars) fell back to proportional text rendered over visible vertical comb ticks.
defects.after: form-review/1706/after/print-p2.png (fixed via shared [data-overflow-of] white band at 8835479d; per-form comb mask removed)

defects.what: Classification* column is blank on print even though 'Residential' is selected on screen; html-frozen/1706-2018/writer-cells.json lists j_id391:_1.._8 under not_joined and needs a derived classification code in crates/.

defects.where: Page 2, Schedule 1 (continuation), Area, FMV per TD, FMV per BIR, Fair Market Value, and TOTAL cells
defects.what: Numeric and currency amounts were left-aligned without right padding instead of right-aligned.
defects.after: form-review/1706/after/print-p2.png (right-aligned via neon-4 shared rule 0f484378 in crates/bir-print/src/frozen_html.rs; no per-form alignment CSS)

defects.where: Page 2, Schedule 2 Item 6 (No. of Installments in the contract)
defects.what: Prints '12.00' (5 chars) across a 2-slot integer comb box because bir-core stores/formats frm1706:txtTotalN as a 2-decimal number even with schema-overrides kind:'int'.
defects.after: form-review/1706/after/print-p2.png (fixed via shared branch 8835479d; prints '1 2' without '.00')

defects.where: Page 2, Schedule 2 Item 7 (Date of Installment MM/DD/YYYY)
defects.what: Date of Installment comb cells are blank when Cash Sale is selected (disabled/cleared by Cash Sale rule on screen as well).

defects.where: Part IV Schedule 2, Item 6 (No. of Installments in the contract)
defects.what: Field still formats as decimal '12.00' despite schema-overrides kind:'int' because bir-core formats frm1706:txtTotalN as a decimal.

defects.where: Part IV Schedule 1, OCT/TCT/CCT No. and Area (sq.m.)
defects.what: Labels used abbreviated 'TCT/OCT/CCT' and 'Area' instead of official 'OCT/TCT/CCT No.' and 'Area (sq.m.)'.

defects.where: Part I (Seller/Buyer Name & Address) and Part IV Schedule 1 (Location)
defects.what: Long text inputs clip horizontally inside narrow (~240px) fields.

shared_changes_wanted: crates/bir-core: store/format frm1706:txtTotalN on screen as integer (not 2-decimal '12.00').
nsh/screens/form/: widen long single-line text inputs (names, addresses, locations) to use available card width instead of clipping at ~240px.

html_frozen_upstream_edits.reason: Plain text inputs in Part I (Items 6A/7A seller & buyer name/address) and Page 2 Schedule 1 (OCT/TCT/CCT, TD No., Location, Lot/Improvement) have padding:0 from .fi and otherwise sit flush against their left cell border.

upstream_buwiz_forms_html.generator_rule: tools/formgen/emit.py: field_css_rules() (~line 4829, .fi currently emits padding:0) or field_input_markup() (~line 4739, slot_index is None plain-field branch)

non_html_frozen_print_edits.change: Removed hardcoded !important font-size overrides on #p1c24-i, #p1c25-i, #p1c47-i, #p1c48-i so bir-print dynamic shrink-to-fit sizes long seller/buyer names and addresses.
